```{=html}
<div class="alien-hand-demo" role="img" aria-label="Земляне посылают через межзвёздное пространство сообщение «Подними левую руку!». Радиально-симметричный восьмирукий октопус, показанный сверху, отвечает «Какую левую?!»: после поворота вокруг оси все его руки и глаза неразличимы">
  <div class="alien-demo-kicker">
    <span>сеанс межпланетной связи</span>
  </div>

  <svg viewBox="0 0 1500 500" aria-hidden="true">
    <defs>
      <linearGradient id="earth-panel-gradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
        <stop offset="0" stop-color="#0b2434"/>
        <stop offset="1" stop-color="#07131b"/>
      </linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="alien-panel-gradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
        <stop offset="0" stop-color="#102b2a"/>
        <stop offset="1" stop-color="#071817"/>
      </linearGradient>
      <radialGradient id="alien-body-gradient" cx="35%" cy="28%" r="75%">
        <stop offset="0" stop-color="#a4f7d8"/>
        <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#47c7a1"/>
        <stop offset="1" stop-color="#176b63"/>
      </radialGradient>
      <filter id="alien-glow" x="-40%" y="-40%" width="180%" height="180%">
        <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="5" result="blur"/>
        <feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
      </filter>
      <marker id="alien-arrow-earth" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
        <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#ffad5a"/>
      </marker>
      <marker id="alien-arrow-octopus" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
        <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#75ddb8"/>
      </marker>
      <g id="alien-tentacle">
        <path d="M 0 -66 C -16 -103 -18 -143 0 -184" fill="none" stroke="#4cc5a3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="28"/>
        <circle cx="0" cy="-184" r="14" fill="#4cc5a3" stroke="#9df1d2" stroke-width="3"/>
        <circle class="alien-sucker" cx="-7" cy="-128" r="4" fill="#153f3a" stroke="#9df1d2" stroke-width="2"/>
        <circle class="alien-sucker" cx="5" cy="-151" r="4" fill="#153f3a" stroke="#9df1d2" stroke-width="2"/>
      </g>
      <g id="alien-eye-unit">
        <ellipse class="alien-eye-white" cx="0" cy="-45" rx="12" ry="17" fill="#f5fff9" stroke="#163b36" stroke-width="3"/>
        <circle class="alien-eye" cx="0" cy="-48" r="6" fill="#182229"/>
        <circle class="alien-eye-glint" cx="-2" cy="-51" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
      </g>
    </defs>

    <rect class="alien-scene-panel" x="12" y="12" width="560" height="420" rx="24" fill="url(#earth-panel-gradient)"/>
    <rect class="alien-scene-panel" x="928" y="12" width="560" height="420" rx="24" fill="url(#alien-panel-gradient)"/>
    <text class="alien-panel-title" x="40" y="54">ЗЕМЛЯНЕ</text>
    <text class="alien-panel-title" x="956" y="54">ОКТОПУС · ВИД СВЕРХУ</text>

    <!-- Землянин и его столь же убедительная зеркальная копия. -->
    <g class="earth-person earth-person-a">
      <circle class="earth-head" cx="164" cy="142" r="39"/>
      <path class="earth-hair" d="M126 139 Q130 92 164 98 Q198 92 203 137 Q184 117 164 120 Q143 116 126 139Z"/>
      <circle class="earth-eye" cx="150" cy="142" r="4"/>
      <circle class="earth-eye" cx="178" cy="142" r="4"/>
      <path class="earth-smile" d="M148 160 Q164 174 181 159"/>
      <rect class="earth-shirt earth-shirt-a" x="117" y="183" width="94" height="132" rx="36"/>
      <path class="earth-leg" d="M143 306 L132 380"/>
      <path class="earth-leg" d="M186 306 L198 380"/>
      <path class="earth-arm earth-arm-rest" d="M122 205 Q83 239 71 286"/>
      <g class="earth-wave earth-wave-a">
        <path class="earth-arm earth-arm-left" d="M205 205 Q237 165 253 109"/>
        <circle class="earth-hand earth-hand-left" cx="253" cy="105" r="15"/>
      </g>
      <text class="earth-name" x="164" y="410">мы</text>
      <g class="earth-left-label">
        <rect x="190" y="62" width="82" height="31" rx="15"/>
        <text x="231" y="84">левая</text>
      </g>
    </g>

    <line class="earth-mirror" x1="292" y1="80" x2="292" y2="389"/>
    <path class="earth-mirror-shine" d="M284 95 L300 130 L284 170 L300 215 L284 260 L300 305 L284 350"/>
    <text class="earth-mirror-label" x="292" y="412">зеркало</text>

    <g class="earth-person earth-person-b">
      <circle class="earth-head" cx="420" cy="142" r="39"/>
      <path class="earth-hair" d="M381 137 Q386 92 420 98 Q454 92 459 139 Q441 116 420 120 Q399 117 381 137Z"/>
      <circle class="earth-eye" cx="406" cy="142" r="4"/>
      <circle class="earth-eye" cx="434" cy="142" r="4"/>
      <path class="earth-smile" d="M404 159 Q420 174 437 160"/>
      <rect class="earth-shirt earth-shirt-b" x="373" y="183" width="94" height="132" rx="36"/>
      <path class="earth-leg" d="M399 306 L388 380"/>
      <path class="earth-leg" d="M442 306 L454 380"/>
      <path class="earth-arm earth-arm-rest" d="M462 205 Q501 239 513 286"/>
      <g class="earth-wave earth-wave-b">
        <path class="earth-arm earth-arm-left" d="M379 205 Q347 165 331 109"/>
        <circle class="earth-hand earth-hand-left" cx="331" cy="105" r="15"/>
      </g>
      <text class="earth-name" x="420" y="410">зеркальные мы</text>
      <g class="earth-left-label">
        <rect x="312" y="62" width="82" height="31" rx="15"/>
        <text x="353" y="84">левая</text>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Обе реплики находятся между мирами, в межзвёздном пространстве. -->
    <g class="alien-interstellar-space">
      <circle cx="620" cy="76" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="688" cy="350" r="3"/>
      <circle cx="744" cy="38" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="818" cy="390" r="2"/>
      <circle cx="886" cy="92" r="3"/>
      <text x="750" y="46">МЕЖЗВЁЗДНОЕ ПРОСТРАНСТВО</text>
    </g>

    <g class="alien-radio-link alien-radio-outbound">
      <path class="alien-radio-line" d="M590 125 C680 78 820 78 910 125" marker-end="url(#alien-arrow-earth)"/>
      <circle class="alien-radio-pulse pulse-one" cx="610" cy="115" r="7"/>
      <circle class="alien-radio-pulse pulse-two" cx="610" cy="115" r="7"/>
      <circle class="alien-radio-pulse pulse-three" cx="610" cy="115" r="7"/>
      <rect class="alien-message alien-message-earth" x="610" y="132" width="280" height="62" rx="31"/>
      <text class="alien-message-text" x="750" y="171">Подними левую руку!</text>
    </g>

    <g class="alien-radio-link alien-radio-return">
      <path class="alien-radio-line" d="M910 330 C820 378 680 378 590 330" marker-end="url(#alien-arrow-octopus)"/>
      <circle class="alien-radio-pulse pulse-one" cx="890" cy="342" r="7"/>
      <circle class="alien-radio-pulse pulse-two" cx="890" cy="342" r="7"/>
      <circle class="alien-radio-pulse pulse-three" cx="890" cy="342" r="7"/>
      <rect class="alien-message alien-message-octopus" x="632" y="252" width="236" height="62" rx="31"/>
      <text class="alien-message-text" x="750" y="291">Какую левую?!</text>
      <text class="alien-message-note" x="750" y="414">после поворота ничего не изменилось</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Вид сверху: восемь одинаковых рук и восемь одинаковых глаз. -->
    <g class="alien-octopus">
      <g class="alien-tentacles" transform="translate(1208 225)">
        <use href="#alien-tentacle" transform="rotate(0)"/>
        <use href="#alien-tentacle" transform="rotate(45)"/>
        <use href="#alien-tentacle" transform="rotate(90)"/>
        <use href="#alien-tentacle" transform="rotate(135)"/>
        <use href="#alien-tentacle" transform="rotate(180)"/>
        <use href="#alien-tentacle" transform="rotate(225)"/>
        <use href="#alien-tentacle" transform="rotate(270)"/>
        <use href="#alien-tentacle" transform="rotate(315)"/>
      </g>
      <circle class="alien-body" cx="1208" cy="225" r="84" fill="url(#alien-body-gradient)"/>
      <g class="alien-eye-ring" transform="translate(1208 225)">
        <use href="#alien-eye-unit" transform="rotate(0)"/>
        <use href="#alien-eye-unit" transform="rotate(45)"/>
        <use href="#alien-eye-unit" transform="rotate(90)"/>
        <use href="#alien-eye-unit" transform="rotate(135)"/>
        <use href="#alien-eye-unit" transform="rotate(180)"/>
        <use href="#alien-eye-unit" transform="rotate(225)"/>
        <use href="#alien-eye-unit" transform="rotate(270)"/>
        <use href="#alien-eye-unit" transform="rotate(315)"/>
      </g>
      <circle class="alien-axis-ring" cx="1208" cy="225" r="15"/>
      <circle class="alien-axis-dot" cx="1208" cy="225" r="5"/>
    </g>

  </svg>

  <div class="alien-demo-summary">
    <span><b>Земля:</b> тело подсказывает картинку</span>
    <span><b>Зеркальная Земля:</b> подсказывает обратную</span>
    <strong>Нужен физический опыт, который не сохраняет чётность.</strong>
  </div>
</div>
```
